subject: FinLytics POC — Week 3 status & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finlytics.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: FinLytics POC — Week 3 status & next steps

Thanks again for a productive call today, Oliver/Priya — quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned for the POC evaluation window. Please reply if anything below needs to change.

Success criteria (proposed):
- Intent classification accuracy >= 90% (goal: 95% for top 3 intents)
- Response latency (95th percentile) < 350ms for 1kQPS simulated workload
- End-to-end throughput support for batch inference of 5k records within 2 hours
- No PII leakage flagged in sample audit criteria (see attached doc)

POC evaluation plan & owners:
- FinLytics to provide representative sample dataset (Priya) by EOD Fri Jul 9. (See POC data instructions attachment.)
- Redwood to provision a dedicated test endpoint + temporary API keys (Marcus). Target: Wed Jul 8.
- Run weekly evaluation scripts (Redwood/FinLytics joint) and share results every Tuesday. Monica will set up dashboards and telemetry access.
- Decision checkpoint after 3 weeks (target week of Jul 27) to discuss expansion or adjustments.

Attachments: finlytics-success-criteria-v1.pdf, POC-data-instructions.xlsx

Next immediate asks:
1) Priya: confirm dataset delivery timeline (EOD Jul 9) and whether data contains sensitive PII fields (so we can mask).
2) Oliver: confirm if the 95% goal for top-3 intents is acceptable; if not, please propose target.
3) Marcus: confirm provisioning ETA for the test endpoint and temporary creds.
I'll follow up mid-week with provisioning details.
Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finlytics.com>
Cc: Andrew Cole <andrew.cole@finlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinLytics POC — Week 3 status & next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear plan. Quick responses inline and a small tweak on success criteria: 

On Tue, Jul 7, 2026 at 3:02 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Success criteria (proposed):
> - Intent classification accuracy >= 90% (goal: 95% for top 3 intents)
> - Response latency (95th percentile) < 350ms for 1kQPS simulated workload
> - End-to-end throughput support for batch inference of 5k records within 2 hours
> - No PII leakage flagged in sample audit criteria (see attached doc)

We confirm the plan and timeline. Couple notes:
- We can aim for 95% on the top 3 intents, but if you can show steady improvement across 3 weeks that's fine — we'll evaluate trends as well as absolute numbers.
- We'll deliver a masked sample dataset by end of day Fri Jul 9. Priya will own this.
- Please provide temporary test credentials — Andrew will run the early runs and will need access.
Small ask: can you include a sample evaluation notebook or scripts we can run on our side to reproduce the metrics? That will speed up our internal validation.
Oliver
Head of ML Engineering | FinLytics
oliver.grant@finlytics.com | +1 (415) 555-0987
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finlytics.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinLytics POC — Week 3 status & next steps

Perfect — thanks for the quick confirmation, Oliver. A few delivery items from Redwood: 

- Temporary test credentials: https://redwood.app/temporary-creds/finlytics-poc (expires in 14 days). Andrew, use these for the first runs; reach out if you need longer access.
- Evaluation artifacts: attached a short evaluation notebook and updated success criteria (finlytics-success-criteria-v1.1.pdf). The notebook reproduces the intent accuracy and latency checks we discussed.
- Provisioning: Marcus confirmed the dedicated test endpoint will be live by EOD today (Jul 9). Marcus — can you reply here once provisioning is complete and include the endpoint URL + sample curl?
Monica will share a read-only dashboard link once telemetry is live; she'll also add Andrew as a viewer.
Key reminders: dataset format should match the sample template in POC-data-instructions.xlsx (no headers, CSV UTF-8, text column named "utterance"). If there are PII fields you cannot remove, flag them to Priya and we'll apply masking prior to ingestion.
I'll set up our first weekly sync for Tue Jul 13 at 9:00 AM PT — calendar invite to follow.
Thanks — looking forward to seeing the sample data.
Best,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: finlytics-success-criteria-v1.1.pdf, evaluation-notebook.ipynb]
